snippet.title: Muffles' Life Sentence Episode 2 Trailer
snippet.description:
Muffles' Life Sentence Episode 2: Odessa Under Snakes is coming March 7th.

Wishlist now and get ready for new places, faces, characters, and cards.
▶Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3145370/Muffles_Life_Sentence/ 

🎭 Take back your identity in Muffles’ Life Sentence- a darkly quirky RPG set in a prison where inmates are transformed to match their crimes.

Being made by @BossyPino.

▶Discord: https://discord.com/invite/DTTS7STeVY
